definitions.gloss: opening a store; starting a business
definitions.explanation: The act of opening a new shop or business for the first time.
A store opening its doors for the day's business, as opposed to being closed.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{開店|かいてん}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to open the store next month.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しいカフェが{開店|かいてん}した。
examples.english: A new café opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{夢|ゆめ}だった{自分|じぶん}の{店|みせ}をついに{開店|かいてん}することができた。
examples.english: I was finally able to open my own shop, which had been my dream for many years.

examples.japanese: {開店|かいてん}は{朝|あさ}10{時|じ}です。
{開店|かいてん}{前|まえ}から{行列|ぎょうれつ}ができていた。
examples.english: There was already a line before the store opened.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}のパン{屋|や}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{開店|かいてん}と{同時|どうじ}にお{客|きゃく}さんが{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる。
examples.english: At the popular bakery, customers flood in the moment it opens every morning.

notes:
USAGE:
{開店|かいてん} has two related but distinct uses: (1) opening a new business for the first time, and (2) a store opening its doors each day. The context usually makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開店|かいてん}する (to open a store)
- {開店|かいてん}{祝|いわ}い (opening celebration gift)
- {開店|かいてん}{時間|じかん} (opening time)
- {開店|かいてん}セール (opening sale)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {開業|かいぎょう}: opening a business (broader; includes offices, clinics, practices)
- {開店|かいてん}: opening a store (specifically retail shops and restaurants)
- {閉店|へいてん}: closing a store (the opposite of {開店|かいてん})
